title: Product circuit gate list
statement: For each natural number $k$, define a gate list recursively. At $k=0$ the list consists of the constant-one gate; at $k+1$, append to the list for $k$ the gate for input $x_k$ when $k<n$ (and the constant-one gate otherwise), followed by an addition gate with node indices $0$ and $3k+1$, and a multiplication gate with node indices $3k$ and $3k+2$.
